title: "DataFest Organizing Committee"
format: html

Below are the organizing committee members for ASA DataFest 2026. Please feel free to reach out to us at `nudatafest@gmail.com`.


```{=html}
<style>
:root {
  --df-purple: #4E2A84;
  --df-purple-dark: #3b1f63;
  --df-text: #2f2f35;
  --df-muted: #6b7280;
  --df-border: rgba(78, 42, 132, 0.12);
  --df-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(46, 16, 84, 0.10);
  --df-card-bg: #ffffff;
}

.category-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: stretch;
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.category-label-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 90px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.category-label {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--df-purple);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--df-purple);
  padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

.member-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.member-grid.three {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(180px, 1fr));
}

.member-grid.two {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(180px, 1fr));
}

.member-card {
  background: var(--df-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--df-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--df-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
}

.member-card img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center 20%;
  display: block;
}

.member-info {
  padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem 0.75rem;
}

.member-name {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--df-text);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
}

.member-email {
  color: var(--df-muted);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .member-grid.three {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .member-grid.three,
  .member-grid.two {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .category-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .category-label-wrap {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    min-height: auto;
  }

  .category-label {
    transform: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="category-row">
```
